# Rotation and Entry Requirements Checklist: LEVA round starter

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the rotation rule and round-entry display requirements before tasks and implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Focus: rotation rule (game rule) and round-entry display. Depth: standard.
Audience: PR reviewer, before `/speckit-tasks`.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is "registration order" defined precisely enough to fix "player 1" (e.g. does reordering players in setup, if possible, change it)? [Clarity, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Do FR-003 and FR-004 read as one rule, or does FR-003 alone ("next player in registration order") contradict the skip of eliminated players? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Is "lives left" pinned to a moment (after the previous round is confirmed) so the eligible set for the next starter is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Is the position and form of the "Começa" mark specified (beside the name, text vs. badge), so two implementations would agree? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Do User Story 1 scenario 3 (starter marked in the guesses step) and FR-006 (rotated list and mark in both steps) agree on the results step? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is the Clarifications example (A, B, C, D → rounds 4–7 start D, A, B, D) consistent with User Story 2 scenario 1 and the data-model table? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §US2]
- [x] CHK007 Does spec 007's Assumptions ("Out of scope: … who starts") need a pointer to this spec so the two do not contradict? [Consistency, Conflict]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Is the starter defined when a fix to a past round changes who is alive, so the derived starter of a later round is a player not in that later round's stored players? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "Fixing a past round"]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified whether a stored round the rules reject advances the rotation or not? [Gap, Plan research D4]
- [x] CHK010 Is the case "several players out in the same round, including the starter and the next in line" covered by a requirement or an example? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements stated for matches already in progress, including one whose current draft has guesses entered when the feature ships? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Is the starter's behaviour with exactly two players after nobody is out, and with the minimum after an elimination, defined (alternation, end of match)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is it stated whether the roster can change during a match (add/remove player) and, if so, how the rotation reacts? [Gap, Assumption]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK014 Is the starter required to be conveyed to assistive technology, not only visually? [Gap, Accessibility]
- [x] CHK015 Is the "Começa" mark required to keep the 360 px / no sideways scroll constraint with a 10-player list and long names? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can SC-003 ("tell who starts within a glance, under 2 seconds") be objectively measured, or should it be restated as an observable condition (starter first in the list, marked, no scroll)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Does SC-001 name the matches to test (players, eliminations) so "100% of the tested matches" has a defined set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Reviewed 2026-11-13 at the owner's request; all 17 items pass after these spec changes:
  - CHK001, CHK013: setup has no reordering and players are fixed during a match (Assumptions, Clarifications).
  - CHK002, CHK003, CHK008: FR-003 is now one rule over each round's own players (living players for the round being entered, players who played it for a stored round); FR-004 follows from it.
  - CHK004, CHK014, CHK015: FR-006 fixes the mark as visible text "Começa" in the name row, read with the row, name truncating first.
  - CHK005: User Story 1 scenario 3 covers both steps.
  - CHK006, CHK010: User Story 2 rewritten with both examples, matching data-model.md.
  - CHK007: spec 007 "Out of scope" points to this spec.
  - CHK009: FR-005, rejected rounds do not advance the rotation.
  - CHK011, CHK012: edge cases for in-progress drafts, two players, removing the last round.
  - CHK016, CHK017: SC-003 restated as observable; SC-001 names four matches.
